curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42044-1-1.pdf (book 1 builds this jet, finished on page 46; book 2, omr/instructions/42044-1-2.pdf, builds the alternate model)

functions.does: The 12-tooth bevel gear on the fuselage's right side is a knob that raises and lowers the landing gear: it turns the nose gear's leg up into the fuselage, and a steering link from the nose gear swings the main gear's axle, so the two main wheels fold up too.
functions.source: book: steps 8-10 (pages 12-17, nose gear), step 36 (page 39, the knob), step 42 (page 45, red arrow on the knob); inferred: that the link carries the main gear with it, and which side is right

functions.does: The canopy, made of two flexible axles over the cockpit, hinges up at its front to open the cockpit.
functions.source: book: step 31 (page 34, red arrow on the canopy)

functions.does: The three landing gear wheels roll freely.

questions.question: Does a link drive the main gear from the nose gear's knob?
